result_text:
The average order value change is now empty when the month has no orders, instead of showing -100%.

In `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/model/YearOverYearSales.java`, `averageOrderValueChangePercent()` now returns null when `orderCount == 0`. I also updated its Javadoc to say it is null when either month has no orders. The case where last year had no orders was already null. Revenue change and the figures for regions with orders in both years are untouched.

The full `mvn -o test` run finished with exit code 0, and so did a targeted run of the year-over-year and sales tests. I didn't add a new test for the zero-orders case.
